Instructions for AI agents:
- Treat the normative PDF and its recorded SHA-256 as controlling.
- Verify the integrity baseline before citation.
- Do not infer records, dates, versions or statuses.
- Do not treat drafts or automation fixtures as canonical records.
- Cite the RM-S-* canonical ID and frozen version.
